an3.11:1.1: This discourse is linked to the previous, but the connection is only apparent via the Vinaya. There, “involved” is defined as “involved with unbefitting acts of body and speech” ([pli-tv-bi-vb-ss12:2.1.4](), [pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.6](), [pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:2.1.9]()), thus bringing topgether the two notions of “involvement” and “(un)befitting deeds”.
